overview: Based on the published agenda, the Community Life, Infrastructure and Public Property Committee of Kronenwetter was scheduled to meet to address the 2027-2036 Capital Improvements Program budget. This ten-year capital planning document is significant for guiding the village's infrastructure investments and development priorities over the coming decade.
committee: Community Life, Infrastructure and Public Property (CLIPP) Committee

discussions.body: The committee was scheduled to discuss and take possible action on the ten-year Capital Improvements Program budget covering fiscal years 2027 through 2036. This agenda item was set to review the village's planned infrastructure investments and capital projects for the upcoming decade.

publicComment: Public comment was scheduled on the agenda, limited to 15 minutes total with three minutes per person.
actionItems: Scheduled to discuss and take possible action on the 2027-2036 Capital Improvements Program Budget
title: Community Life, Infrastructure and Public Property (CLIPP) Committee Meeting - 2026-10-05
